name: Shigeki
description: The orochi who bonded with a nature kami, had a prophetic dream and founded the Order.

description_citations.text: "Order of Jukai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shigeki promises to give invaders a taste of their poison.
timeline.quote: Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land.

citation.text: Fang of Shigeki (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shigeki says the soul of Jukai reaches beyond the forest.
timeline.quote: The soul of Jukai reaches far beyond the forest's edge.

citation.text: Kodama's Reach (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The orochi Shigeki bonds with a nature kami, has a prophetic dream of the spirit realm shattering, and founds the Order of Jukai.
timeline.quote: When the orochi Shigeki bonded with a nature kami, he experienced a prophetic dream of the spirit realm shattering.

citation.text: "Order of Jukai", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: Founder of the Order of Jukai.
